name: SayCan
architecture: Language relevance multiplied by learned skill feasibility.
training: Pretrained LLM plus skill policy/value learning.
data: Language pretraining and robot skill experience.
inference: Select skill, execute, repeat.
contribution: Connects semantic intent to executable abilities.
limitations: Fixed skills; incomplete failure feedback.
openness: Tabletop simulation code and instruction dataset.

name: PaLM-E
architecture: Continuous sensor embeddings inserted into decoder language model.
training: Joint multimodal and embodied task learning.
inference: Generate plan; execute through separate policies; add feedback.
limitations: Large compute; low-level execution remains separate.
openness: Paper/project; full public weights not verified.

name: EmbodiedGPT
architecture: Prefix-tuned 7B language model plus planning-query features.
training: EgoCOT adaptation and downstream control training.
inference: Plan and extract features for controller.
limitations: Benchmark-specific transfer.
openness: Paper; release completeness not audited.

name: VIMA
architecture: T5 prompt encoder; cross-attention causal decoder.
inference: Autoregressively choose actions and observe outcomes.
limitations: Procedural simulation and object-token assumptions.
openness: Code, weights, benchmark and dataset linked.

name: VoxPoser
architecture: LLM-generated programs compose VLM-grounded 3D value maps.
inference: Recompute maps and plan trajectories with feedback.
limitations: Perception/calibration/planner assumptions.
openness: Project provides code and prompts.

name: R3M
architecture: Visual encoder with temporal and language-alignment objectives.
inference: Encode observations for learned policy.
limitations: No direct actions or transition model.
openness: Paper links code and pretrained models.

name: VC-1
architecture: MAE-pretrained vision transformer.
inference: Encode sensor input for downstream policy.
limitations: Adaptation and task protocol determine transfer.
openness: Models/code described as released.

name: PerAct
architecture: Perceiver over voxel and language tokens.
inference: Predict keypose; planner executes.
limitations: Voxel cost and RGB-D calibration.
openness: Official code, tutorial and checkpoints.

name: RVT
architecture: Virtual-view rendering and cross-view transformer.
inference: Fuse views, predict pose, execute.
limitations: View construction and protocol dependence.
openness: Official project links code and trained model.

name: 3D Diffuser Actor
architecture: 3D relative attention conditions pose denoising.
inference: Denoise action; execute with task controller/planner.
limitations: Quaternion and benchmark conventions matter.
openness: Code, weights and data links.

name: DreamerV3
architecture: Recurrent latent dynamics and actor-critic.
inference: Infer state, act; update model and policy.
limitations: Exploration, rewards and model error; not universal weights.
openness: Official algorithm code; paper/author project.

name: UniSim
architecture: Conditional video diffusion trained across data domains.
data: Images, videos, robot and navigation data.
inference: Simulate transitions for planner/policy learning.
limitations: Task-bounded transfer and model exploitation.
openness: Paper/project; full reproduction not verified.

name: Genie
architecture: Video tokenizer, latent action model and autoregressive dynamics.
inference: User action selects generated next frame.
limitations: Latent controls not calibrated motor actions.
openness: Research paper; open full checkpoint not verified.

name: Genie 2
architecture: Autoregressive latent diffusion with causal dynamics.
inference: Generate next frame conditioned on actions.
limitations: Consistency and physical validity remain limited.
openness: Official research demonstration.

name: Genie 3
architecture: Detailed architecture not disclosed in checked source.
action_representation: Limited direct actions; promptable world events
inference: Real-time interactive world generation.
contribution: Higher resolution and longer coherent interaction.
limitations: Minutes-long horizon, action and multi-agent limits.
openness: Official model page and gated Project Genie prototype.

name: GR-1
architecture: GPT-style joint image/action sequence model.
data: Large video data; CALVIN and real robot trajectories.
inference: Predict actions and future images; execute actions.
limitations: Joint prediction not equivalent to explicit planning.
openness: Project/paper; release completeness not audited.

name: GR-2
architecture: Scaled generative video-language-action model.
training: Video pretraining then joint video/action fine-tuning.
inference: Generate robot actions with visual predictions.
contribution: Scales temporal pretraining for policy generalization.
limitations: 97.7% is the 105-task Simple setting; unseen manipulations remain substantially harder.
openness: Paper; complete public reproduction not verified.

name: V-JEPA 2
architecture: Encoder/predictor with masked latent targets.
inference: Encode and predict latent visual structure.
limitations: Base model is not a direct controller.
openness: Code and model family released.

name: V-JEPA 2-AC
architecture: Action-conditioned predictor on pretrained latent encoder.
training: Post-train dynamics with robot video/action records.
inference: Optimize image-goal latent distance with MPC.
limitations: Action data used; small task collection and planning latency.
openness: Official code/checkpoint and planning components.

name: V-JEPA 2.1
architecture: Dense/deep predictive supervision; image/video tokenizers.
data: Scaled image/video corpus; DROID robot data.
inference: Improved features support goal-directed MPC.
limitations: Grasp gain depends on planning budget; ten tasks per skill.
openness: 80M/300M/1B/2B models and code released.

name: Cosmos Predict 2.5
architecture: Video generative foundation model.
data: Physical-world video data; full corpus not audited.
inference: Generate conditional future video.
limitations: Visual generation alone does not establish robot control.
openness: NIM deployment and available model artifacts.

name: Cosmos Policy
architecture: Predict2-2B with action/state/value encoded as latent frames.
data: Robot demonstrations; optional policy rollout data.
inference: Direct policy or best-of-N imagined planning.
contribution: Video priors become policy, dynamics and value.
limitations: Search adds compute; training is platform-specific.
openness: Official code, checkpoints and data links.

name: Cosmos 3
architecture: Autoregressive reasoner plus diffusion generator, Mixture-of-Transformers.
data: Physical AI mixtures; specific DROID checkpoints.
inference: Reason independently or generate futures/actions.
contribution: Unifies world understanding, prediction and action.
limitations: Mode/hardware limits; Edge lacks video-to-video transfer.
openness: Super64B/Nano16B/Edge4B; current OpenMDW-1.1.

name: GAIA-2
architecture: Latent multiview generative dynamics.
inference: Simulate action-conditioned driving futures.
limitations: Driving-specific; not manipulation policy.
openness: Paper/official media; open weights not verified.

name: GAIA-3
architecture: Detailed architecture not established in checked release.
inference: Generate scenarios for evaluation/validation.
limitations: Official report, not independent safety proof.
openness: Official release; no open weights verified.

name: GAIA-4
architecture: Learned multimodal simulator; architecture incompletely disclosed.
data: Driving sensor logs; full recipe undisclosed.
inference: Actions alter next camera/radar inputs.
contribution: Behavioral counterfactual evaluation in a sensor loop.
limitations: Simulation assumptions and fidelity bound validation.
openness: Official technical account; no full open reproduction verified.

name: Cosmos Predict2-2B
architecture: Latent video diffusion model used as Cosmos Policy initialization.
action_representation: No robot controls in the base model.
data: Video pretraining data; complete corpus not audited.
inference: Generate conditional future frames.
contribution: Reusable temporal priors for subsequent policy adaptation.
limitations: Base video generation is not calibrated robot control.
openness: Base checkpoint identified by Cosmos Policy paper and code.
